title: PCR Master Rubric Import
description: Schema for Rubric Manager > Import JSON in index.html. Either a bare array of items, or an object with a 'rubric' array (the shape produced by Export, so exports round-trip). Import REPLACES the entire stored rubric; existing compliance ratings re-attach by item id.

id.description: Official indicator identifier (e.g. 'CQ.A.2'), unique across the file. Compliance ratings attach by this id, and gateParent references it.

serviceLine.description: ihs=In-Home Supports, hh=Host Home, sl=Supported Living, ids=Individualized Day Supports, comp=Companion, resHab=Residential Habilitation, dayHab=Day Habilitation, respiteD=Respite (Daily), respiteH=Respite (Hourly), suppEmp=Supported Employment, empReady=Employment Readiness. An indicator used by several service lines appears once per line with a distinct id.

domain.description: Outcome/domain grouping; indicators render grouped under it in file order.

weight.description: 0 for GATE and QI items; 5 = critical indicator (feeds the critical score); 1, 3, 10, and 15 are the remaining QA weights in the official Qlarant set.

type.description: QA counts toward certification scores; QI is an unweighted quality-improvement measure (Satisfaction-domain QI items feed the Excellent-tier satisfaction check); GATE is a Yes/No applicability control.

alert.description: true: scoring this Not Met overrides the tier display and triggers the mandatory 30-day Follow-Up PCR banner.

gateParent.description: id of the controlling GATE item (same service line, present in this file), or null. Gate answered No forces this item to N/A, excluded from scoring, controls disabled. Single-level only: a GATE item must have gateParent null — model nested gates as sibling gates with their own flagKey.

flagKey.description: GATE items only: the client attribute flag that pre-answers this gate (flag true = Yes, false = No). QA can override per review. Null on non-gate items.

intentText.description: Interpretive guide — what the surveyor actually looks for. Shown inline under 'Show what the surveyor looks for'.

appliesTo.description: "all", or an array of living arrangements the indicator applies to. Entries must exactly match the configured strings.

hcbsSettings.description: true marks an HCBS Settings indicator: 100% of rated HCBS indicators must be Met for the Excellent tier.

effectiveDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the import date if omitted.

active.description: false = retired: kept in history and the Rubric Manager, excluded from reviews and scoring. Never hard-delete retired items — send them with active:false.
